title: NADEC Becomes an Early Adopter of ISO/IEC 42001:2023 in Saudi Arabia, Reinforcing Its Leadership in Responsible AI and Digital Innovation
summary: NADEC's Digital & Technology Division has successfully achieved ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification, the world's first international standard for Artificial Intelligence
full_content: NADEC's Digital & Technology Division has obtained ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification, making it an early adopter of the world's first international standard for Artificial Intelligence Management Systems (AIMS). The certification encompasses Infrastructure & Operations, Applications, Strategy & Governance, Information Security, and Digitalization Services. This accomplishment demonstrates NADEC's dedication to implementing responsible and transparent AI governance practices aligned with global standards.
